name: Tiles Wave
description: The tiles of the first clip turn over in a wave, up each column and then across, each showing the second clip on its back. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: flip_x
params.description: Turn the tiles around a vertical axis

params.name: flip_y
params.description: Turn the tiles around a horizontal axis

params.name: duration
params.description: How long each tile takes to turn over, in tile steps
